pages.title: +1 Speed Keyboard Lucky Escape
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Fire Lucky Blocks across a giant keyboard in +1 Speed Keyboard Lucky Escape. Uncover more valuable Brainrot characters, improve your speed, and run when Tung Tung comes after you.

pages.title: PopSortica
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Sort pieces on an underwater trip in PopSortica. Watch for special conditions and obstacles as each board changes, and use a booster when the layout makes a move difficult.

pages.title: Scala 40
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Build sets and runs in Scala 40. Reach forty points to put down your first combinations, then draw and discard as you work toward an empty hand.

pages.title: Free Hoops
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Move metal bars to guide elastic loops into the boxes in Free Hoops. Think about where each loop will go, then use the bands to wrap and break objects.

pages.title: Last Stand Warrior
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hold off waves of enemies in Last Stand Warrior. Use attacks and skills to stop the advancing crowd, and improve your weapons and abilities as the defense gets tougher.

pages.title: Minicraft Chef Cake Wars
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Race a friend to gather cake ingredients in Minicraft Chef Cake Wars. Collect the materials from balloons and try to pick up more than your rival before the round ends.

pages.title: Wood Color Block
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Slide wooden pieces to their matching crushers in Wood Color Block. Look for a path through the other pieces and clear the board before the countdown reaches zero.

pages.title: MeatRider
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Choose an armed vehicle in MeatRider and take it through a world full of zombies. Use its weapons and special ability to make space as you fight to survive.

pages.title: Hidden Pairs Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find pairs of open tiles in Hidden Pairs Mahjong. Remove matching symbols and see what each pair exposes. Keep working through the available matches until the board is clear.

pages.title: Pentaword
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Guess a five-letter word in six tries in Pentaword. Use each tile's feedback to keep correct letters in place and try other positions for letters that belong elsewhere.

pages.title: Block Crasher
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Fire colored bubbles at moving blocks in Block Crasher. Time each shot to hit a matching color and adjust as the targets change position to keep scoring.

pages.title: Gangsta Island: Crime City
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Take on heists and rival crews in Gangsta Island: Crime City. Work through the activities and mini-games as you expand your influence around the city.

pages.title: Coin Merge
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Sort coins by color into their slots in Coin Merge. Complete a slot to produce a new coin, and plan your sorting as the pace increases in later levels.

pages.title: Mahjong Riddles: Egypt
pages.creator: Star Mill B.V.
pages.description: Pair tiles to recover artifacts in Mahjong Riddles: Egypt. Work through locations around the Nile and Giza, uncovering stories about pyramids, pharaohs, and hieroglyphs as you solve boards.

pages.title: Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Clear card layouts with Foxy in Solitaire Story TriPeaks 5. Play cards next to the current rank and draw from the stock when needed. Each solved board takes you farther on the trip.

pages.title: Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Switch between three vehicles in Hill Climb Truck Transform Adventure. Pick the one that suits the terrain, balance it over ramps, and look for repair pickups after a collision.

pages.title: Pop Them!
pages.creator: Tummy Games DOO
pages.description: Chain three or more emojis of a color in Pop Them! Link in any direction to clear obstacles around boxes or troublesome emojis, and finish before your moves run out.

pages.title: BFFs Y2K Fashion
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Build early-2000s outfits in BFFs Y2K Fashion. Browse pieces such as skater skirts, ripped jeans, and T-shirts, then mix them into a look from the era.

pages.title: Cooking in the City of Winds
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Make festival dishes in Cooking in the City of Winds. Prepare smooth pudding, tapioca bubble tea, and Hocus-Pocus marmalade as you work through the culinary activities.

pages.title: CCG - Car Crash Game
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Take a car through races and stunts in CCG - Car Crash Game. Use nitrous when you need speed and see how collisions affect the bodywork.

pages.title: Fashion Box: Glam Diva
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Help Bonnie style a glam look in Fashion Box: Glam Diva. Try different pieces for the life-in-plastic challenge and see how they work together before settling on her outfit.

pages.title: Noob Shooter Zombie
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Fight through swarms of cube-shaped zombies in Noob Shooter Zombie. Keep looking ahead as new enemies appear and line up shots before they get too close.

pages.title: Speedy Golf
pages.creator: Unit Radius
pages.description: Play an eighteen-hole par-72 course in Speedy Golf. Aim with the arrows and use three taps of the swing button to set the shot's power and spin.

pages.title: Hospital Hustle
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description: Run a clinic in Hospital Hustle. Bring resources to the machines so they can treat patients, then hire and upgrade staff as the hospital gets busier.

pages.title: Mike And Mia Beach Day
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Spend a day at the shore in Mike And Mia Beach Day. Pick beach clothes and join the two friends for volleyball, fishing, surfing, and a picnic.

pages.title: Beaver's Blocks
pages.creator: Nord Beaver
pages.description: Fit pieces onto the grid in Beaver's Blocks. Think about how the shapes can complete a section and keep open spaces available for the pieces that come next.

pages.title: The Kitchen - Find the Differences
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Find the changes between two pictures in The Kitchen - Find the Differences. Click or tap a detail only when you've checked it, since repeated mistakes can end the round.

pages.title: My Perfect Weekend Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Prepare outfits for the Rainbow Girls in My Perfect Weekend Outfits. Browse different combinations and give each friend a look for the activities she has planned.

pages.title: Pixel Smash Duel
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Knock your opponent off a platform in Pixel Smash Duel. Jump to avoid shots and fire back when you have the angle. The first player to score five wins.

pages.title: Colorful Racing
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Race vintage-styled cars in Colorful Racing, including the Mercedes-Benz 500 K and Walker Rocket. Steer with WASD or the arrows and press space to use nitro.

pages.title: Candy Connect
pages.creator: Pidomtech
pages.description: Work through hexagonal candy puzzles in Candy Connect. Plan how to connect the pieces as the boards get more demanding, and take your time with the untimed layouts.

pages.title: Just Vote!
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Choose the answer you think most people would give in Just Vote! Read each prompt and see how often your pick matches the most popular opinion.

pages.title: Dibbles. Pro Pack
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Guide the king through dangerous layouts in Dibbles. Pro Pack. Assign jobs to the Dibbles so the ruler can get past obstacles in thirty-three puzzles made for returning players.

pages.title: Drift Parking
pages.creator: FK
pages.description: Slide into the right space in Drift Parking. Choose where to park before you initiate the drift, then steer so the car comes to rest in its assigned spot.

pages.title: Among Them Painting Book
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Paint crewmate pictures in Among Them Painting Book. Pick colors and click the illustration with the brush, then pop the onscreen balloons when you're done.

pages.title: Clara Flower Farming Game
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dress Clara for gardening in Clara Flower Farming Game. Help plant roses and sunflowers in the backyard, then take the flowers to market once they're ready.

pages.title: Halloween Spooky Dessert
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare themed sweets in Halloween Spooky Dessert. Use the mouse to follow recipes for cakes, cookies, or baked snacks and work through each preparation step.

pages.title: Bridal Race 3D
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Collect bridal pieces while running the elevated course in Bridal Race 3D. Slide to steer toward outfit upgrades and try to get past your rivals on the runway.

pages.title: Platfoban
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Switch between jumping and pushing blocks in Platfoban. Collect every coin and remember that chests are platforms in one mode and enemies in the other.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Boom
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Work through a chain of color changes in Sweet Candy Boom. Follow the order shown at the start and turn the candies green so you can destroy them.

pages.title: TRZ Pop it
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Press every bubble on each toy in TRZ Pop it. Complete a shape to unlock the next one, with eighty different toys to work through.

pages.title: Tank Hero Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fire cannons at enemy tanks in Tank Hero Online. Pick up power-ups as you fight and spend coins on better ammunition, armor, or guns for your vehicle.

pages.title: Sort Them All
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Separate balls into their matching bins in Sort Them All. Choose a color to collect, guide those balls to the right bin, and repeat until the layout is clear.

pages.title: Avoid Dying
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Draw the bow and aim in Avoid Dying. Drag to line up the target and release to fire. A careful shot keeps the stickman's attempt alive.

pages.title: Two Tunnel 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Move a ball around the tunnel in Two Tunnel 3D. Tap left or right to avoid gaps, and be ready to turn sooner as the ball picks up speed.

pages.title: Virus Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Connect matching virus tiles in Virus Mahjong Connection. Look for a pair with a clear route between them, then use the space it leaves to open up more links.

pages.title: Real Car Parking Mania Simulator
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Choose a vehicle in the garage in Real Car Parking Mania Simulator. Drive sports cars and other models, then work on positioning the car as you approach a parking spot.

pages.title: Kids Memory with Birds
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Turn over cards to discover birds in Kids Memory with Birds. Remember where each bird appeared and match the pictures until every pair on the board is found.

pages.title: US Commando
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Join an elite squad on the battlefield in US Commando. Move through the combat area and take on the assault objectives while watching for enemies ahead.

pages.title: Valentines Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Remove pairs of matching holiday tiles in Valentines Mahjong Deluxe. Tap the pieces you can pair and look for matches that reveal the remaining Valentine's Day items.

pages.title: Cute Kitty Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose from four kitten pictures in Cute Kitty Coloring. Use the mouse or touchscreen to add colors and see how different palettes change each of the drawings.

pages.title: Clash Of Stickman Warrior
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Fire at rival stickmen in Clash Of Stickman Warrior. Press space to shoot and work out when to take each shot as you complete the missions.

pages.title: Blue Roses Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build jigsaws of an anime character with flowers in Blue Roses Puzzle. Choose one of six pictures and decide how many pieces you want to fit together.

pages.title: Flat Out
pages.creator: JZJO.COM
pages.description: Clear a road of zombies in Flat Out so the town's residents have a way out. Move through the route and take down as many of the undead as you can.

pages.title: Mahjong Christmas
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Pair identical holiday symbols in Mahjong Christmas. Work through the layout of 144 tiles and look for moves that uncover more matches while the carol plays.

pages.title: Kylie Vs Kendall Oscars
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Kylie and Kendall prepare for the red carpet in Kylie Vs Kendall Oscars. Try outfit choices for both sisters and see what suits each one for the event.

pages.title: Mountain Mini Car Racer
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Take on mountain courses in Mountain Mini Car Racer. Race computer-controlled drivers or compete against the clock, and work on your cornering across the different tracks.

pages.title: Super Buddy Kick 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Hit a ragdoll in Super Buddy Kick 2 to collect coins. Spend what you earn on other weapons and see how each one affects the dummy.

pages.title: Happy Piggy
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Gather coins for the piggy in Happy Piggy. Use the mouse to work through each setup and try to get the coins to the pig.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Bloodbath
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Jump and fly to the beat in Geometry Dash Bloodbath. Watch for hazards ahead and time each input as the rhythm and the course change.

pages.title: City Metro Bus Simulator 3D
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Take the wheel of a city bus in City Metro Bus Simulator 3D. Practice driving the larger vehicle and give yourself room to line it up on parking approaches.

pages.title: Merge 13
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Connect numbers by dragging through them in Merge 13. Look for sequences in neighboring or diagonal spaces and use each connection to make progress on the board.

pages.title: Crowd City War
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Build a crowd in Crowd City War by gathering people around the city. Steer toward groups you can recruit and confront rivals once you have enough people.

pages.title: Modern Home Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Compare pictures of rooms in Modern Home Difference. Pick out the small details that change between the two views and keep searching until you've found the required differences.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Alien Friend
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Look after a visitor from space in Baby Hazel Alien Friend. Help Hazel complete the care activities, then work with her to send the little alien home.

pages.title: Crazy Rush.io
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Steer around rivals in Crazy Rush.io with the mouse and press space for a quick rush. Save the burst for when you have an opening to attack or move away.

pages.title: Kids Bedroom Decoration
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description: Decorate a room in Kids Bedroom Decoration. Try different colors, patterns, and soft furnishings, then see how the pieces look together in your own bedroom design.

pages.title: EG Karate
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Kick attackers coming from both sides in EG Karate. Time each strike to knock enemies into the river, and react faster as the game picks up speed.

pages.title: Pizza Rush
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Launch toppings at a moving pizza in Pizza Rush. Click or tap to strike ingredients with the knife, and time each shot so the topping lands on the pizza.

pages.title: Multiplication Math Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Work out multiplication answers in Multiplication Math Challenge. You have ten seconds for each question, so select the correct result promptly and keep building your score.

pages.title: Pocket Pool
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Line up shots in Pocket Pool and use the cue ball to send other balls into the pockets. Check the angle to the pocket before you take each shot.

pages.title: Space Driving
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Fly a ship through narrow canyons in Space Driving. Steer toward rings that appear along the route and react quickly when the next opening is somewhere different.

pages.title: Pregnant Fashion Night
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Style two expectant princesses in Pregnant Fashion Night. Choose an outfit for each competitor and see how your selections come together on the runway.

pages.title: Ellie Coachella Makeup
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Get Ellie ready for Coachella in Ellie Coachella Makeup. Begin with a spa session, then experiment with color and glitter to finish her festival makeup.

pages.title: Space Car
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Drive a car through a low-gravity setting in Space Car. Keep the vehicle moving as meteors appear and try to raise the score before the run ends.

pages.title: The Last Survivors
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Guide two characters through puzzles in The Last Survivors. Use each survivor to help the other past obstacles and work out how to get them both through.

pages.title: Snake Attack
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Eat fruit to grow in Snake Attack. Use the arrow keys to turn and keep clear of the snakes that chase you as you search for more food.

pages.title: Airport Buzz
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Manage arrivals in Airport Buzz. Guide planes in on time and improve airport buildings as you take charge of busy airports in different parts of the world.

pages.title: Moorhuhn Shooter
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Use the mouse to shoot chickens in Moorhuhn Shooter. Watch the scene for a target and aim before it moves away. Try to hit as many as you can.

pages.title: Princesses Thrift Shop Challenge
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Help Cinderella remake a thrift-store find in Princesses Thrift Shop Challenge. Turn a secondhand garment into a different piece and style it with clothes from her wardrobe.

pages.title: Princess Wardrobe Perfect Date 2
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Put together a fresh date look in Princess Wardrobe Perfect Date 2. Try makeup and eyeshadow first, then choose clothing and accessories for the outing.

pages.title: Ice Queen Royal Baker
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Bake a cake with the Ice Queen in Ice Queen Royal Baker. Follow her recipe as you prepare it and choose how to decorate the finished dessert.

pages.title: Princess Daily Fun
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Plan outfits for Rapunzel's day off in Princess Daily Fun. Pick something comfortable for a park walk with Kristoff and something stylish for shopping with Ariel.

pages.title: Princess Secret Santa
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Pick gifts for Elsa, Moana, Ariel, and Mulan in Princess Secret Santa. After they draw names, help each princess choose a present that suits the friend she drew.
